shortDescription: Manage VLANs on Ubiquiti Edgeswitch network devices

options.name: auto_exclude
options.description: Each of the switch interfaces will be excluded from I(vlan_id) unless defined in I(*_interfaces). This is a default setting for all switch interfaces.

options.name: auto_tag
options.description: Each of the switch interfaces will be set to accept and transmit untagged frames for I(vlan_id) unless defined in I(*_interfaces). This is a default setting for all switch interfaces.

options.name: auto_untag
options.description: Each of the switch interfaces will be set to accept untagged frames and transmit them tagged for I(vlan_id) unless defined in I(*_interfaces). This is a default setting for all switch interfaces.

options.name: excluded_interfaces
options.description: List of interfaces that should be excluded of the VLAN. Accept range of interfaces.

options.name: purge
options.description: Purge VLANs not defined in the I(aggregate) parameter.

options.name: tagged_interfaces
options.description: List of interfaces that should accept and transmit tagged frames for the VLAN. Accept range of interfaces.

options.name: untagged_interfaces
options.description: List of interfaces that should accept untagged frames and transmit them tagged for the VLAN. Accept range of interfaces.
